heading: IIT Bombay suicide case: Zoho's Sridhar Vembu backs Prof Doolla booked over ‘casteist slurs’ — SC/ST Act ‘weaponised’
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: IIT Bombay Professor Suryanarayana Doolla was booked in the case pertaining to the suicide of a 22-year-old student of IIT Bombay, who was allegedly caught using his mobile phone during an examination.
